source: SYNTHETIC - no real candidate. Fabricated fixture for contract testing.
_fixture_note: This is a fabricated example candidate, not a real person's resume. It exists so the JSON contract has a concrete reference and so scripts/validate_structured_json.py has something to self-test against. It deliberately exercises: a rank-0 P1 role (chart floor below rank 1), a same-employer promotion staircase at two different employers, a multi-family role with a secondary family that is never dominant (operations - palette entry but no legend pill), a concurrent side gig at the same rank as a main role (lane-splitting), and an off-chart pre-career role.

candidate.name: Rowan Ellis
candidate.summary: Analytics leader with a decade in applied modelling, moving from entry-level analysis into managing a data science team.

roles.title: Analytics Manager
narrative_bullets: Manage a team of five analysts and data scientists, owning hiring, performance reviews, and compensation recommendations for the group.
Set the quarterly analytics roadmap in partnership with Product and Finance, and own the team's tooling budget.
Rebuilt the customer-churn model that now drives retention outreach for roughly 40,000 accounts.
Introduced a peer code-review standard for notebooks and pipelines, cutting rework on recurring reports.

strata.name: Manager
strata.reasoning: Bullets give explicit hire/perf/comp authority over direct reports plus budget ownership - the M4 test from the Manager decision tree. No Team Lead layer beneath, so not M5.

family_tags.reasoning: Team and roadmap are data-science work; leadership job type carries the weight.
Meaningful share of the role is planning and budget rather than modelling.

role_type.reasoning: Five direct reports with full authority.

connector.notes: IC to manager track at the same employer.

roles.title: Senior Data Scientist
narrative_bullets: Owned the forecasting domain end to end, from data contracts through model deployment and monitoring.
Built and shipped the demand-forecasting service used by the supply planning team.
Mentored two junior analysts through their first production model launches.
Ran the weekly model-performance review with Product and Operations stakeholders.

strata.name: Senior
strata.reasoning: Sole ownership of one domain (forecasting) with mentorship but no delegated people authority - textbook P4. No initiative-level or program-level leadership language that would justify P5.

family_tags.reasoning: Primary output is applied modelling with a real engineering component.

job_types.reasoning: Supply planning partnership and stakeholder review cadence.

family_tags.reasoning: Recurring operational partnership is a genuine sub-focus, not incidental.

roles.title: Adjunct Instructor, Applied Statistics
narrative_bullets: Taught one evening section of Applied Statistics per term to a mix of returning and first-year students.
Designed the course's project-based assessment, replacing a single final exam.

strata.name: Senior
strata.reasoning: Subject-matter delivery within one course, self-directed but narrow scope. Teaching is not program leadership - the P5 trap called out in the common-mistakes list.

family_tags.reasoning: Entirely teaching work; no second family applies.

connector.notes: Concurrent evening side gig alongside the Northvale role.

roles.title: Data Scientist
narrative_bullets: Delivered client-facing segmentation and propensity models across retail and subscription accounts.
Became the team's reference point for feature-engineering conventions on new client projects.
Presented model results directly to client analytics leads.

strata.name: Middle
strata.reasoning: Fully productive IC completing client work unsupervised and acting as a knowledge source for juniors; scope is per-project, not domain ownership, so below P4.

industry.name: Technology & Software
industry.reasoning: Analytics consultancy serving software and retail clients.

connector.notes: Promotion out of the entry-level track.

roles.title: Data Scientist I
narrative_bullets: Supported senior scientists on client engagements, building and validating feature sets under review.
Maintained the team's shared data-cleaning utilities.

strata.name: Entry Professional
strata.reasoning: Title-gated: the 'I' suffix is an explicit entry-level marker, which is the only basis on which P1 may be assigned. Bullets independently show supervised, scoped work.

strata.name: Junior
strata.reasoning: Routine supervised service work. Not P1 - the title carries no entry-level marker, and P1 is title-gated.

render_policy.exclusion_reason: Pre-career student job in an unrelated family; excluded from the ladder by default per the off-chart pre-career rule. Flip to on_chart if the user wants a maximal-history view.
